d: Platinum white hair, styled in wavy curls and an elegant updo with a side-swept fringe. Pale green eyes with a wide, surprised expression. An adult with a mature, refined facial structure. A slender, upright build wearing a white high-collared shirt, a light grey cinched waist-corset, deep navy trousers, and dark brown heeled boots. A heavy, layered cloak in shades of deep plum and burgundy with a black feathered mantle draped over the shoulders, accessorized with a red rose on the lapel and a golden chain. Holding a golden ornate staff with a spiral design and a sword sheathed at the hip.
